item.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

item.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

item.title: X expands its ‘Gametime’ sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: X is turning its NFL-focused Gametime feature into a year-round sports destination, starting with MLB and with other professional leagues to follow.

item.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.

item.title: Greenairy is building smart plant towers to clean the air in your office
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: As it turns out, the cure for stuffy, chemical-infused office air might be a tower of leafy greenery.

item.title: CIA officer admits to creating fake top secret government program to steal over $190M, including gold bars
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: CIA officer David Rush, who worked on highly sensitive intelligence programs, reached a plea deal with U.S. prosecutors after he was caught siphoning money and gold with a fake government contract.

item.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.

item.title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.

item.title: Bloom raises $3.6M to become the ‘Alibaba’ of American manufacturing
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The Detroit startup has widened its scope beyond mobility to help drone and robotics companies find U.S.-based manufacturers, shippers, and more.

item.title: SpaceX alumni nab $100M to rethink shipping with autonomous freight trains
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Parallel Systems raised $100 million to scale production of its autonomous electric rail vehicle, which can shuttle thousands of pounds of freight up to 500 miles.

item.title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

item.title: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground for users to build browser-based games using simple text prompts.

item.title: Get hands-on: The full lineup of interactive roundtables at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026

item.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.

item.title: Ring’s first smart lock can be hand-cranked when its battery dies
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Amazon-owned Ring is entering the smart lock market with a device designed to tackle a common concern: getting locked out when the battery dies.

item.title: Another personal AI assistant has launched — Meet Tab, which emerged from stealth with a $300M valuation
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: A new personal AI assistant has arrived. Meet Tab, which announced Tuesday that it had officially emerged from stealth.

item.title: Spotify expands audiobooks to over 180 markets
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Spotify will make 350,000 titles available in over 120 languages for this expansion.

item.title: How to find out if Amazon thinks you have ‘flat buttocks’
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: "I stumbled upon a page of assumptions that Amazon has made about me based on my purchases and I’m literally speechless," one shopper wrote on Threads.
